DeviceHealth.description:
Vital signs of a device at observation time (capability ``health``).

Every value is optional: devices report very different subsets. Values change on every
observation; rules compare them with thresholds and the history, never as drift.
DeviceHealth.title: DeviceHealth

DeviceTime.description:
Clock, time zone and NTP of a device (capability ``time``).

``clock`` is the device's time when it was read and ``read_at`` Signalbox's own time at that
moment, so :meth:`offset_seconds` is the device's clock error, give or take
``uncertainty_seconds`` (half the request's round trip).
DeviceTime.title: DeviceTime

FrameTypes.description: Which frames a port accepts on ingress (802.1Q acceptable frame types).
FrameTypes.title: FrameTypes

Neighbour.description: A device seen on a port by LLDP (or a similar protocol).
Neighbour.title: Neighbour

Network.description: The merged view of all sites: what rules, topology and UI work on.
Network.title: Network

Port.description:
A port of a device.

``up`` is the link state. The configuration details below (from ``description`` on) are
filled only where the device reports them, as part of the ``interfaces`` capability;
``None`` (or an empty list) means "not reported", never "off".
Port.title: Port

PortMedia.description: Physical medium of a wired port (wireless ports are ``PortKind.WIRELESS``).
PortMedia.title: PortMedia

PurposeSource.description: Where a purpose came from. Declared beats reported beats heuristic.
PurposeSource.title: PurposeSource

ReadError.description: A capability that was declared but could not be read: becomes an "incomplete" finding.
ReadError.title: ReadError

Segment.description: A layer-2 network (VLAN) of a site.
Segment.title: Segment

SegmentPurpose.description: What a network is for: the vocabulary users think in ("my IoT network").
SegmentPurpose.title: SegmentPurpose

Snapshot.description: Everything one adapter observed on one device at one time.
Snapshot.title: Snapshot

Source.description: Where an observed object came from.
Source.title: Source

Uplink.description:
A gateway's connection to its provider (WAN), ``object_id(device, "uplink", <name>)``.

Read with the ``interfaces`` capability. WAN addresses are not :class:`Subnet` objects: the
uplink is not a network of the site. The public address and the delegated IPv6 prefix
identify the household: shown in the UI behind a click, never exported (MQTT, reports).
Uplink.title: Uplink

UplinkKind.description: How a gateway reaches its provider (or the router in front of it).
UplinkKind.title: UplinkKind

UpsStatus.description: A UPS monitored by the device (NUT on OPNsense, ``/system/ups`` on MikroTik).
UpsStatus.title: UpsStatus
